meta.question: on Waterbirds K=29, is the trustfilt student (higher WGA than Full KD) closer to the full teacher than the Full KD student on the worst group, or is its worst-group gain not imitation of the teacher?
meta.method: teacher-student output divergence per group on held-out images, seed-paired t CI, run-level Spearman with permutation p, image bootstrap
meta.paper: Hinton et al. 2015 (KD); Stanton et al. NeurIPS 2021 (does KD really work? student-teacher fidelity); Son et al. ECCV 2024 (MaskedKD); Sagawa et al. ICLR 2020 (Waterbirds groups)
